integrity: All embedded text and standalone checker bytes are individually hashed and byte-counted; finite original-matrix verification is independent of the proof and is not a proof of infinite or arbitrary-field statements.
scientific_limitations: Exact counting is restricted to finite characteristic-two fields and exactly five generators; arbitrary characteristic-two fields have the structural ranks but no cardinality polynomial. Counts elements and not distinct ideals. Independent mathematical validation and exhaustive priority verification are not performed.
title: Exact multiplication-rank census in the five-generator elementary-abelian group algebra
